summary: This Dockerfile creates a Docker image for running Cypress end-to-end tests. It starts with a pre-built Cypress image, installs the project's npm dependencies, copies the test files and configuration into the container, verifies the Cypress installation, switches to a non-root user for security, and sets up the container to run Cypress tests in Chrome by default.

explanations.5: The `--chown=node:node` flag ensures that the copied files are owned by the 'node' user and group rather than root, which is important for permissions when the container later switches to the node user.
explanations.12: This command verifies that Cypress is properly installed and configured in the container before we try to run tests; it's a sanity check that catches setup problems early.
explanations.14: Switching to the 'node' user makes the container run as a non-root user for better security; if someone breaks into the container, they won't have root-level access.
explanations.16: This sets the default command that runs when the container starts; in this case it launches Cypress in headless mode using the Chrome browser to run all tests.
